In the cheat menu

The external MenuTrampas.exe window (which requires enabling Allow cheat menu in Options > Combat and difficulty and, in multiplayer, having the server owner enable permitir_trampas) responds to these keys:

  • Control Tab and Control Shift Tab: switch between tabs and sub-tabs.
  • Tab and Shift Tab: move across the fields and buttons in the current tab.
  • Alt plus the underlined letter or digit of the label or button: jump straight to that control (Alt 1 through Alt 5 for the instance, Connect/Disconnect, Refresh, status and summary).
  • F5: refresh the connection and all synchronized game fields right away.
  • Control H: speak the context help for the currently focused control through the screen reader.
